newsitem.title: USA: Texfi stake raised by Chadbourne group.
newsitem.headline: Texfi stake raised by Chadbourne group.

text.p: A group including Chadbourne Corp said Monday it increased its stake in Texfi Industries Inc to 23.4 percent or 2,043,700 common shares.
In a filing with the Securitie and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 66,000 additional shares of Texfi between NOvember 14 and 26 at prices ranging from $2.50 to $2.60 a shares.
The group said its stake includes 600,000 shares subject to exercise of an option.
The group previously held a 22.6 percent stake or 1,977,700 shares in Texfi, a Raleigh, N.C., producer of woven, knitted and printed apparel fabrics.
Chadbourne, a unit of Halton Ltd, is based in New York.
